undeterminedSystems.reasonSummary: Two were blocked by access controls (HTTP 403 WAF block for Omaha; Cloudflare anti-bot challenge for Nebraska) under the frozen no-bypass rule. One (Las Vegas local) was stopped by the session request cap before a lead link could be inspected.

decisionMappingResult.basis: Among the 6 fully-determined systems (NYC local, NY State, Chicago local, Illinois State, Nevada State, NPS), only one matching pair was found (NYC local + NPS), and that pair involves NRHP, which per Section 12 cannot alone satisfy 'a few recurring adapter patterns.' Fewer than two qualifying recurring pairs exist, so the 'Philadelphia-specific acquisition' condition is met on the determined-system subset.
caveats: This result covers only 6 of the 9 maximum systems; 3 remain genuinely undetermined due to real access barriers (anti-bot/WAF blocks and session-cap exhaustion), not due to any contract failure.

Zero true Section-8 contract failures occurred among any determined system - every reachable system was representable under the existing five-part contract, including the one request-only/login-gated system (NY State), which counts as fit per Section 7.

The access barriers encountered (Cloudflare challenge, WAF 403) are themselves a notable, reportable finding about real-world reconnaissance friction, separate from and not reducible to any of the three frozen decision-mapping buckets.
Per Section 13's guardrail, this result establishes observed shapes/gaps only, not national prevalence.
